rows.paper_says: f is admissible if d'(f(p),f(q)) ≤ d(p,q) for all p,q (label-decreasing; translations of operations are admissible because they preserve every congruence).
rows.lean_says: Admissible color placement := ∀ left right, color left right ≤ color (placement left) (placement right) (label-increasing). With the ⊥-iff-equal condition such maps are injective, hence (on a finite set) colour-preserving automorphisms.

rows.paper_says: For every nonempty edge set S, vertices p,q with d(p,q) ≤ a_S lie in the same component of Γ_S, whose adjacencies are images {f(p),f(q)} of edges of S under admissible (label-decreasing) self-maps.
rows.lean_says: For every nonempty Finset of ordered pairs, color l r ≤ sup implies EqvGen of Marked, where Marked uses the reversed Admissible. The structure (images of seeds, equivalence closure, a_S as a sup) matches, but the set of placements is only automorphisms, so the condition is strictly stronger. A concrete 4-vertex colouring satisfying the paper's condition fails Lean's.

rows.lean_says: Carrier Fin size with 0 < size; symmetry; color l r = ⊥ ↔ l = r; color l r ≤ color l m ⊔ color m r; reflection condition identical.

rows.paper_says: L is the full congruence lattice of a finite algebra iff a coloured graph satisfying (i)–(iii) with label-decreasing placements exists.
rows.lean_says: Representable Lat ↔ HasGraphWitness Lat, with HasGraphWitness using the label-increasing (automorphism-only) connectivity. That amounts to saying L is the congruence lattice of a finite permutation-group action, which the paper never claims for an individual lattice (it notes that Pálfy–Pudlák is not a per-lattice equivalence). The ← direction is weaker than the paper's; the → direction is stronger and not supported by the paper's proof.

rows.paper_says: Theorem 1.1: The Euclidean plane has no proper five-coloring, even with arbitrary color classes; consequently 6 ≤ χ(R²) ≤ 7.
